heading: EXT. DRIFTING LIFE RAFT, OPEN OCEAN - DAWN

units.text: EXT. DRIFTING LIFE RAFT, OPEN OCEAN - DAWN
Flat grey sea.
A pale sun.
The raft rocks gently on swells too slow to feel.
Four survivors sit in the orange hull.
CAPTAIN MAGDALENA OYELARAN-STROUD (50s, sunburnt scalp, torn epaulettes) holds a tin cup of rainwater with both hands.
Beside her, first officer DESMOND PRIESTLEY-ADEKUNLE (40s, a bandaged forearm) scans the horizon with a cracked sextant.
In the middle, a passenger, ROSALIND FAIRBANKS-NAKAMURA (30s, gold watch, salt-white hair), whispers to a drowned photograph.
At the stern, deckhand TIBERIUS "TIBBY" OKONJO (20s, shirtless, ribs showing) trails a fishing line in the water.
Divide it.
units.name: MAGDALENA

units.text: It's a thimble each.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: Then divide a thimble.
units.name: MAGDALENA

units.text: She hands him the cup.
He drinks his share and passes it to Rosalind, who stares at it without lifting it.
Tibby doesn't look up from the line.
Got something.
units.name: TIBBY

units.text: Don't pull.
units.name: DESMOND

units.text: It's pulling me.
units.name: TIBBY

units.text: The line goes taut.
Tibby braces, boots on the rubber hull, then leans back with a roar.
Magdalena grabs his belt, Desmond hooks an arm around her waist, and Rosalind, still clutching the photograph, tumbles into a heap with all three as a flash of silver hurls itself over the side.
They tangle.
A gleaming fish thrashes on the floor of the raft, spraying water on every face.
Magdalena pins it, Tibby clubs it with the cup, and silence returns.
Dinner.
units.name: TIBBY

units.text: Dinner.
units.name: MAGDALENA

units.text: Rosalind lifts her head and, for the first time, smiles.
